_comment: Eligibility window per league. max_days_out doubles as the commenceTimeTo bound on the odds fetch (one knob fixes volatility + volume) AND, since predictions.js applies no separate date filter, as the real lookahead cap on locked picks (CLV strategy, matching ShadowB-Soccer). requires = data-readiness gate (lock only when the signal is present) -- NOT YET ENFORCED in code as of 2026-08-26, kept as documentation of intent. edge_scale_per_day: effective_threshold = base * (1 + edge_scale_per_day * days_to_game), so far-out locks must clear a higher bar -- also NOT YET ENFORCED. Starting values per architecture proposal; §11.3 monthly job replaces these with measurement.
